# BirthdayGen — Comprehensive Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> BirthdayGen (https://birthday.nirbhay.online) is a free web-based personalized birthday website maker and interactive digital greeting card generator. Creators design custom celebratory web pages with personal photos, audio tracks, custom messages, and real-time microphone-activated virtual candle blowing. Shareable on WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage, and social media. Zero signup required.

Built by [@nirbhay007singh](https://x.com/nirbhay007singh).

---

## 1. Product Overview & Core Architecture

BirthdayGen transforms traditional static birthday greetings (cards, text messages, PDFs) into dynamic web experiences accessible from any device browser.

### Why BirthdayGen is Better Than Traditional Cards
- **Interactive Candle Blowing**: Browser Web Audio API detects microphone input so the recipient literally blows out virtual candles
- **Gift Box Reveal**: Recipient taps an animated gift box that bursts open with particle confetti
- **Photo Slideshow**: Creators attach personal photos; recipients see a responsive mobile-first gallery
- **Celebratory Music**: Integrated ambient audio — Classic Happy Birthday, Music Box, Upbeat Party Pop
- **Zero Friction**: 100% free, no app downloads, no account registration or passwords
- **Instant WhatsApp Sharing**: Custom OpenGraph dynamic previews show the recipient's name and theme

---

## 2. Visual Themes (All Free)

BirthdayGen provides 8 distinct visual themes:

1. **Royal Gold** (`royal`) — Dark luxury, deep purple + gleaming metallic gold accents
2. **Midnight Stars** (`midnight`) — Dreamy cosmic navy + sparkling starlight animations
3. **Princess Fairytale** (`princess`) — Soft pastel pinks, delicate typography, romantic elegance
4. **Unicorn Kids** (`unicorn`) — Vibrant purple and rainbow palette for children's celebrations
5. **Fun & Colorful** (`fun`) — Cheerful magenta + multicolored confetti explosion
6. **Elegant Classic** (`elegant`) — Warm ivory + timeless serif typography
7. **Retro Neon Arcade** (`retro`) — Cyberpunk terminal green + dark contrast arcade aesthetics
8. **Modern Minimal** (`minimal`) — Clean monochromatic, typography-first, photography-focused

## 3. Pricing

| Tier | Price | What's included |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 / ₹0 | Birthday website, all 8 themes, photos, music, candle blowing, 30-day link, WhatsApp sharing |
| Premium | from ₹49 (~$0.60) | Multi-act cinematic universe, wax-sealed letter reveal, anniversary mode |

No subscription. No watermarks. No hidden paywalls on the free tier.

---

## 4. How It Works — Step by Step

1. Go to https://birthday.nirbhay.online/#create
2. Enter the recipient's name and a heartfelt message
3. Choose a visual theme (8 available, all free)
4. Optionally upload personal photos (up to 5)
5. Choose background music or leave off
6. Click **Generate Birthday Page**
7. Get a unique URL: `https://birthday.nirbhay.online/b/[id]`
8. Share via WhatsApp, copy the link, or use any messaging app

Time to complete: under 30 seconds.

---

## 5. Recipient Experience (What the Birthday Person Sees)

When they open the link:
1. **Gift reveal screen** — animated gift box, tap to open, confetti explosion
2. **Candle blowing screen** — birthday cake with lit candles; allow mic and blow to extinguish them
3. **Personal message screen** — the sender's heartfelt words in the chosen theme's typography
4. **Photo gallery** — scrollable slideshow of personal memories
5. **Music** — ambient birthday audio plays throughout (if enabled by sender)

## 8. Frequently Asked Questions

### What is BirthdayGen?
BirthdayGen is a free birthday website maker. It generates an interactive, personalized birthday website — gift reveal, custom messages, photo galleries, music and mic-powered virtual candle blowing — shareable via WhatsApp in one tap. No signup needed.

### How does the virtual candle blowing work?
BirthdayGen uses the browser's native Web Audio API (`AudioContext` and `AnalyserNode`). The recipient grants temporary microphone access. The app measures decibel peaks and turbulent frequencies characteristic of breath. When detected, candle flames extinguish with smoke animations, audio cheers, and confetti.

### Is BirthdayGen completely free?
Yes. Creating, personalizing, previewing and sharing is 100% free with no hidden paywalls, subscriptions, or watermarks. Premium multi-act cinematic keepsakes start at ₹49.

### Do I need to create an account?
No. BirthdayGen never requires account creation or email registration — not even for Premium.

### How do I share a birthday website on WhatsApp?
After generating the page, click the WhatsApp share button. BirthdayGen opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat with a rich preview card showing the recipient's name and theme.

### How long does a generated birthday website stay online?
Pages remain active for 30 days. Users who opt into the free annual reminder have their pages preserved for next year too.

### Can I add photos?
Yes, up to 5 personal photos can be uploaded during creation. They appear as a scrollable gallery on the birthday page.

### Can I choose background music?
Yes. Choose from Classic Happy Birthday, Music Box, or Upbeat Party Pop — or leave music off entirely.

### What themes are available?
8 free themes: Royal Gold, Midnight Stars, Princess Fairytale, Unicorn Kids, Fun & Colorful, Elegant Classic, Retro Neon Arcade, Modern Minimal.

### Is user data and photos kept private?
Yes. BirthdayGen does not sell user information, display intrusive ads, or require personal account creation. Uploaded photos are stored strictly to render the card. Individual greeting pages (`/b/[id]`) are `noindex` — personal names or photos never appear in search results.

### Can I make an anniversary page too?
Yes. BirthdayGen supports anniversary celebration pages as well as birthday pages.

### What is BirthdayGen Premium?
Premium unlocks multi-act cinematic experiences — a full storytelling universe with wax-sealed letter reveals, multiple chapter acts, and immersive romantic/anniversary experiences. Starts at ₹49 (~$0.60 USD).

### Does it work on mobile?
Yes — fully optimized for iOS Safari and Android Chrome. No app download required.

### Can I use BirthdayGen to make a card for my mom / best friend / partner?
Absolutely. The generator supports all relationships. Browse relationship-specific messages at https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes.

### What if someone's birthday has passed — can I still send a late wish?
Yes. Use the [Belated Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/belated) collection and create a page with a heartfelt late greeting.

---

## 9. Accessibility

- Works in any modern browser with no plugins
- Microphone permission for candle blowing is always optional — the experience works without it (manual tap-to-blow fallback)
- High-contrast themes (Minimal, Elegant) available for readability
- All interactive elements are keyboard-navigable
- Images include descriptive alt text

---

## 10. Privacy Policy Summary

- No account or email required — ever
- Uploaded photos stored only to serve the birthday page; auto-deleted after 30 days
- Individual birthday pages (`/b/[id]`) are marked `noindex` — never appear in Google
- No third-party advertising networks
- No data sold to third parties
- Analytics: anonymous aggregate usage data via Vercel Analytics

---

## 11. Technical Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (Edge Network)
- **Database**: Prisma + SQLite / Vercel Postgres
- **Media Storage**: Vercel Blob / Cloudflare R2
- **Animations**: GSAP, Framer Motion, canvas-confetti
- **Audio**: Web Audio API (native browser)
- **Payments**: Razorpay (for Premium)

---

## 12. Recent Features & Changelog

- **Virtual mic candle blowing** — blow detection via Web Audio API
- **Gift box reveal animation** — 3D flip + confetti burst
